decision: EXTERNAL LESION ESCALATION VALIDATION NOT ESTABLISHED.
search_scope: Bounded review of existing local dataset/evaluation inventory and publicly documented dataset access/licence metadata. No dataset was silently added to the Phase 7 denominator.

attempts.rights_observation: Official page states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International for the work.
attempts.reason: The installed lesion checkpoint reports IDRiD among its training sources; the local export is image-level without verifiable patient/eye separation. It is comparability evidence, not independent external validation.

attempts.rights_observation: Existing project record treats access and downstream terms as requiring separate review.
attempts.reason: The available local material is a DR grading comparison, not a lesion-ground-truth evaluation; patient separation is not verifiable and lesion rights/annotations are not established.

attempts.rights_observation: The referenced dataset card reports CC BY 4.0, but local acquisition, exact image/annotation manifest, and task-specific lesion ground truth are not present.
attempts.reason: No locally verified, rights-cleared lesion annotation package or patient-separated evaluation manifest was available in the checkout.

attempts.rights_observation: No local licence or provenance manifest was found.
attempts.reason: The local scratch inventory is incomplete (7 images and 50 annotations reported by the audit) and lacks acquisition, grouping, rights, and completeness evidence.

attempts.rights_observation: This is the frozen internal Phase 7 comparison cohort, not an external holdout for Phase 8.
attempts.reason: Reusing it would violate the external-validation question and would collapse the frozen internal evidence boundary.

required_next_evidence: A legally usable lesion-annotated cohort with an auditable artifact manifest
Verified patient/eye separation from all reported training sources
A reproducible run of LESION_ESCALATION_RULE_PHASE7_V1 with per-case provenance and aggregate review burden
Independent review/adjudication of the escalation target
limitations: Public source pages document availability/licence observations only; they do not authorize this repository to redistribute data or weights.
No external image inference was run, so external sensitivity, specificity, burden, calibration, and confidence intervals are NOT MEASURED.
